work: Edmonds 1998, 'Meta-Genetic Programming: Co-evolving the Operators of Variation', CPM Report 98-32, Centre for Policy Modelling, Manchester Metropolitan University; also Turkish J Electrical Eng and Computer Sciences 9(1):13-29
access: FULL_TEXT_READ by an HC-R01 lane, 20-page PDF from cfpm.org
engineered_or_discovered: DISCOVERED variation-generating machinery inside an ENGINEERED co-evolutionary scaffold
online_estimate: YES. Operator fitness is 'the average proportionate change in fitness of the operand genes before and after', computed every generation from 50 sampled operand pairs per operator, with a three-generation running average.
fed_back_into_generation: YES. That measured score IS the operator's fitness, and ordinary GP selection, crossover and mutation then act on the OPERATOR population, constructing the next generation's variation-generating machinery from the better-performing operator trees.
changes_how_possibilities_are_generated: YES. Operators are tree structures over primitives, so genuinely novel operator forms can be assembled. The author reports the composition shifting over a run.
shortfall: the estimate is BACKWARD-LOOKING, a realised fitness effect of operators already applied, not a forward estimate of a distribution over future consequences
author_reported_fragility: the technique failed in initial trials because variation in the base population was destroyed too quickly; needed manual fixes; is sensitive to biases in the operator syntax; and degrades sharply under a depth ceiling, which the author says 'disrupts the effective estimation of the operator's effectiveness'
verdict: CLOSEST HISTORICAL FIT TO PART C

work: Hansen and Ostermeier 2001, 'Completely Derandomized Self-Adaptation in Evolution Strategies', Evolutionary Computation 9(2):159-195
online_estimate: YES. The covariance of the realised, SELECTED mutation steps, cumulated across generations into an evolution path. The authors state the objective explicitly: 'to favor strategy parameter settings that produce selected steps with high probability (again)'.
fed_back_into_generation: YES. The estimated covariance and step size directly parameterise the multivariate normal from which the next generation is sampled.
changes_how_possibilities_are_generated: PARTIAL. It reshapes the sampling distribution to an arbitrary oriented ellipsoid, a real structural change, but the update LAW is fixed by the authors.
shortfall: measures PAST realised-and-selected steps, not future consequences; the future distribution is set by a human-designed law applied to that history
verdict: STRONGEST ENGINEERED ANALOGUE. Precisely specified and robust, which is exactly what Edmonds is not.

work: Adaptive operator selection line: Thierens 2005 adaptive pursuit; Whitacre, Pham and Sarker 2006 'Credit Assignment in Adaptive Evolutionary Algorithms'; Fialho, Da Costa, Schoenauer and Sebag bandit-based AOS
access: FULL_TEXT_READ (partial) by an HC-R01 lane for Whitacre et al; ABSTRACT_ONLY for Thierens
online_estimate: YES, and unusually well instrumented. Per-operator reward from realised offspring, with an explicit choice between direct credit from the immediate offspring's fitness and a 'Search Bias Assumption' crediting operators whose DESCENDANTS turn out fit.
fed_back_into_generation: YES, into a probability vector over which operator to apply next.
verdict: THE CLEAN (i) HALF OF PART C, ENTIRELY DIVORCED FROM (ii). A control system over selection probabilities, never over the generative machinery.

work: Pelikan, Goldberg and Cantu-Paz BOA and hBOA; Harik and Goldberg LLGA and ECGA; Michalski Learnable Evolution Model
online_estimate: NO, in the sense that matters. The model is of the CURRENT SELECTED POPULATION, its joint structure and dependencies, not of the consequences of applying variation.
fed_back_into_generation: YES trivially, because the model IS the generator; but (i) and (ii) collapse into one operation with no measurement of consequences interposed.
verdict: The directive's section-18 distinction is REAL and this family sits squarely on the population-model side. Structurally the most generatively flexible engineered relative, and still not Part C.

work: Spector 2001, 'Autoconstructive Evolution: Push, PushGP, and Pushpop', GECCO-2001
engineered_or_discovered: DISCOVERED, most radically of anything found. Individual programs construct their own children's code; there is no separate crossover or mutation operator at all.
online_estimate: NOT DEMONSTRATED. The Push language provides instructions through which a running program COULD query ambient fitness information, so self-referential estimation is representable, but the paper reports no evolved program observed doing it and no measurement-and-feedback step in the architecture.
changes_how_possibilities_are_generated: YES, and observed: usage of the sexual-recombination instructions spikes after reproductive competence and through a period of major fitness improvement, then shifts by generation 550 to incremental asexual strategies.
verdict: DISCOVERED GENERATION-CHANGE WITH NO CONTROLLER. The substrate affords Part C and the paper does not exhibit it.

work: Altenberg 1994, 'The Evolution of Evolvability in Genetic Programming', in Advances in Genetic Programming, MIT Press, pp. 47-74
access: FULL_TEXT_READ by an HC-R01 lane, sections 3.1 to 3.1.4
engineered_or_discovered: NEITHER, and that is the point
online_estimate: NO, explicitly. Author's own words: 'the constructional fitness is never evaluated by the GP algorithm, nor is it obtained by averaging current program fitnesses'.
fed_back_into_generation: NO. There is nothing to feed back.
changes_how_possibilities_are_generated: YES in outcome. Programs shift 'from innovative code to conservative code as populations mature'.
verdict: THE SHARPEST NEGATIVE IN THE PASS. Proof that evolution of evolvability and change in how variation is generated can occur with ZERO estimation-and-feedback machinery, purely from selection acting at a second level of replication.
standing_consequence: Any future claim to have found a Part-C controller must exhibit the estimate and the feedback pathway. Observing changed variational behaviour is not evidence, and Altenberg's own mathematics is why.

work: Teller 1996, 'Evolving Programmers: The Co-evolution of Intelligent Recombination Operators', Advances in Genetic Programming 2, MIT Press pp. 45-68; extended by Kantschik, Dittrich, Brameier and Banzhaf 1999
access: ABSTRACT_ONLY, via Spector 2001's citation and secondary summaries
engineered_or_discovered: DISCOVERED within an engineered co-evolutionary scaffold
online_estimate: YES per secondary characterisation: operator fitness is the measured fitness effect on the offspring it produces
fed_back_into_generation: YES via selection on an operator population of evolved graph programs
verdict: AN EARLIER INSTANCE OF THE EDMONDS PATTERN, two years before. NOT VERIFIED FROM PRIMARY SOURCE and it should be, because priority matters for a parts claim.

work: Rechenberg 1973 one-fifth success rule; Schwefel 1981 mutative self-adaptation; Baeck 1992 self-adaptive GA; Grefenstette 1986 meta-GA; Cobb and Grefenstette 1993 triggered hypermutation; mutator alleles and stress-induced mutagenesis in Avida and in biology
online_estimate: the success-rate and degradation-trigger rules DO estimate something online, but it is a scalar proxy, not a property of the variation's consequence distribution. Baeck's GA and the mutator-allele line compute NO estimate at all and work purely by hitchhiking.
merely_selects_among_fixed_heuristics: effectively yes for the triggered and meta-GA cases
verdict: EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED by directive sections 18 and 19. Recorded so the exclusion is documented rather than assumed.

work: Genetic-programming hyper-heuristics that GENERATE rather than select heuristics; Burke and colleagues' selection-versus-generation taxonomy
engineered_or_discovered: ENGINEERED scaffold producing DISCOVERED heuristics as output
changes_how_possibilities_are_generated: YES, but one level removed: it changes how solutions to the TARGET problem are generated, while the GP process that constructs the heuristic runs with fixed operators
merely_selects_among_fixed_heuristics: no at the object level, yes at the meta level
verdict: Demonstrates the generate-versus-select distinction is already a named, active distinction in the field, but it is never applied reflexively to the generating algorithm's own operators.
